name: Spider Plains
description: The Spider Plains are wide, hilly fields overrun by skin spiders, which eat the fallen. The Shek Kingdom holds Last Stand, a walled fortress with a bar and shops, where older Shek prepare to die with honor fighting the Bugmaster of neighboring Arach. The hostile Berserkers keep a ruined village here under their leader Ghost, and bands of Kral's Chosen and the Band of Bones also roam.
